Reward requirements: Valid trading volume for a single event ≥ 100 USDT, complete ≥ 6,000 USDT in event trades/event contract trades after registering, and maintain VIP 5 or above at the end of the event.

Batch registration of multiple accounts, malicious volume manipulation, self-trading, matched trading, manipulation of prediction results, fake invitations, fake sharing, arbitraging trial vouchers, exploiting system vulnerabilities, or any other behavior that affects the fairness of the event is strictly prohibited.
Rewards will be distributed within 14 business days after the event ends, following review.
Event Period: November 16, 2026, 08:00 to November 30, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
The more you trade, the more you share. You must maintain VIP 5 or above at the end of the event.

Participants must click the 【Participate Now】 button on the event page to register for the event and complete Identity Verification to receive rewards. This event is open only to eligible designated users. If registration is unavailable on the page, your current account is not eligible to participate. Please refer to the actual display on the event page.
Rewards will be distributed in chronological order based on when the winning streak tier is achieved

Rewards will be distributed within 14 business days after the event ends, following review. If users participate in other Gate events of the same type at the same time, they may receive rewards from only one event. Gate’s backend determination and the rules displayed on the event page shall prevail.

This event does not solicit users in regions where event markets, predictions, contracts for difference, derivatives, or crypto asset trading are prohibited or restricted. Users must not use VPNs, proxies, false identities, delegated operations, or other methods to circumvent regional restrictions, KYC requirements, or platform risk control rules.

Gate event market services may be subject to laws and regulations in the user’s jurisdiction. Users must comply with the Gate User Agreement . Before participating, users should independently confirm the laws and regulations of their location, the platform’s terms of service, and their risk tolerance to ensure that they are eligible to participate. Users in restricted regions may be unable to use all or part of the services, including registration, trading, predictions, claiming rewards, or participating in this event.
Gate VIP Prophet Challenge: Two Tracks Launch Simultaneously.
Leaderboard Track: The more you trade after registering, the more you share. A total prize pool of 12,000 USDT awaits;
Winning Streak Track: Correctly predict 5 consecutive events to claim limited-edition Prophet rewards.
Whether you are an experienced high-frequency bettor or a prophet who can see the outcome at a glance, there is a podium for you here.
Event 1: Leaderboard Challenge
During the event, users who register and reach the corresponding trading volume threshold for valid event trades/event contract trades can receive rewards, with a total prize pool of 12,000 USDT.
Cumulative Trading Volume Requirement
Share 5,000 USDT
Share 3,000 USDT

≥ 3,000 USDT
Event 2: Prediction Winning Streak Challenge
During the event, register and make correct predictions consecutively to earn limited-edition Prophet rewards when your winning streak meets the requirements.
Winning Streak
Quantity
5-Win Streak
VIP Sports Set
7-Win Streak
Whiskey Glass Gift Box
10-Win Streak
Gate Golden Finger
Each event is counted only once toward a winning streak
Only winning streak orders with odds ≥ 1.2 will be counted
Orders in multiple directions for the same event by the same user will not count toward a winning streak
“Consecutive” is determined by settlement time. Any loss on a valid bet ≥ 100 USDT will break the streak, which will then restart
Rewards are based on the highest tier achieved and can be claimed only once; rewards for the same tier will not be distributed repeatedly
Wash trading and abnormal orders will be excluded, and the platform reserves the right to disqualify users

Only valid trades generated in events/event contracts after registration during the event period will be counted. This event counts only trades made with your own funds. Positions and returns associated with event market trading trial vouchers and other subsidized funds will not be counted.

Valid trading volume is calculated based on the actual executed prediction amount, including buying Yes, buying No, and selling on the secondary market. Unfilled orders, unfilled portions of canceled orders, transfers, refunds, and abnormal trades will not be counted.

In the event of event postponement, cancellation, rescheduling, interruption, changes to rulings, market closure, or other force majeure circumstances, Gate reserves the right to adjust, suspend, or cancel the relevant markets and event rewards based on actual circumstances.

Only one eligible main account per verified identity may participate; sub-accounts are not eligible. API users, VIP 15 and above, market makers, corporate accounts, institutional accounts, and restricted accounts are not eligible.

Batch registration of multiple accounts, malicious volume manipulation, self-trading, matched trading, manipulation of prediction results, fake invitations, fake sharing, arbitraging trial vouchers, exploiting system vulnerabilities, or any other behavior that affects the fairness of the event is strictly prohibited. Multiple accounts under the same verified identity will be considered the same participant, and sub-accounts may not participate in the event.

Gate reserves the right to adjust, suspend, or cancel the event rules, prize pool, reward distribution methods, eligibility, and event period based on market conditions, event changes, system abnormalities, compliance requirements, or force majeure factors, without further notice. Gate reserves the final right of interpretation for this event.
